title: agk monitor (live)
description: What the kit runs now and what ran in the chosen stage (issue #284). Numbers and text only.

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT project FROM (SELECT project FROM steps UNION SELECT project FROM launches UNION SELECT project FROM issues UNION SELECT project FROM limits) WHERE project IS NOT NULL ORDER BY project
list.definition: SELECT project FROM (SELECT project FROM steps UNION SELECT project FROM launches UNION SELECT project FROM issues UNION SELECT project FROM limits) WHERE project IS NOT NULL ORDER BY project

list.name: stage
list.label: Stage
list.query: SELECT stage FROM (SELECT stage FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM issues WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM limits WHERE project = '${project}') WHERE stage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY stage DESC
list.definition: SELECT stage FROM (SELECT stage FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM launches WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM issues WHERE project = '${project}' UNION SELECT stage FROM limits WHERE project = '${project}') WHERE stage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY stage DESC

panels.title: Active launches
panels.description: Launches whose newest step (Codex: its stream file) is at most 5 minutes old, at the time of the query. Weighted tokens are an estimate from price ratios.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT a.role, a.model, a.issue, i.title, a.stage, a.provider, a.start_time AS start, CAST(a.run_time_s AS INTEGER) AS run_time_s, a.input_tokens, a.output_tokens, a.cache_creation_tokens, a.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(a.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, a.last_tool, a.last_target, a.live_time AS last_step_time FROM active_launches a LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.project = a.project AND i.issue = a.issue WHERE a.project = '${project}' ORDER BY a.start_s, a.launch
targets.queryText: SELECT a.role, a.model, a.issue, i.title, a.stage, a.provider, a.start_time AS start, CAST(a.run_time_s AS INTEGER) AS run_time_s, a.input_tokens, a.output_tokens, a.cache_creation_tokens, a.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(a.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, a.last_tool, a.last_target, a.live_time AS last_step_time FROM active_launches a LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.project = a.project AND i.issue = a.issue WHERE a.project = '${project}' ORDER BY a.start_s, a.launch

panels.title: Current stage: launches
panels.description: Every launch of the chosen stage from the step rows, in start order. attempt counts the launches per issue and role (2 or more is a retry).

targets.rawQueryText: WITH l AS (SELECT launch, provider, issue, role, MAX(model) AS model, MIN(time_s) AS start_s, MAX(time_s) AS last_s, COUNT(*) AS steps, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens, SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens, SUM(weighted) AS weighted FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) AND launch IS NOT NULL GROUP BY launch, provider, issue, role) SELECT datetime(l.start_s, 'unixepoch') AS start, l.issue, i.title, l.role, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.issue, l.role ORDER BY l.start_s, l.launch) AS attempt, l.provider, l.model, datetime(l.last_s, 'unixepoch') AS last_step_time, CAST(l.last_s - l.start_s AS INTEGER) AS run_time_s, l.steps, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.cache_creation_tokens, l.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(l.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, l.launch FROM l LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.project = '${project}' AND i.issue = l.issue ORDER BY l.start_s, l.launch
targets.queryText: WITH l AS (SELECT launch, provider, issue, role, MAX(model) AS model, MIN(time_s) AS start_s, MAX(time_s) AS last_s, COUNT(*) AS steps, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens, SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens, SUM(weighted) AS weighted FROM steps WHERE project = '${project}' AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) AND launch IS NOT NULL GROUP BY launch, provider, issue, role) SELECT datetime(l.start_s, 'unixepoch') AS start, l.issue, i.title, l.role, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.issue, l.role ORDER BY l.start_s, l.launch) AS attempt, l.provider, l.model, datetime(l.last_s, 'unixepoch') AS last_step_time, CAST(l.last_s - l.start_s AS INTEGER) AS run_time_s, l.steps, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.cache_creation_tokens, l.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(l.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, l.launch FROM l LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.project = '${project}' AND i.issue = l.issue ORDER BY l.start_s, l.launch

panels.title: Codex QA attempts of the stage
panels.description: active: in the active launches; done: a run-record line with provider codex.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 'active' AS status, a.issue, a.model, a.start_time AS start, a.live_time AS last_activity, NULL AS retry, a.input_tokens, a.output_tokens, a.cache_creation_tokens, a.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(a.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, a.launch FROM active_launches a WHERE a.provider = 'codex' AND a.project = '${project}' AND a.stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) AND a.launch NOT IN (SELECT launch FROM launches WHERE provider = 'codex' AND launch IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'done' AS status, l.issue, l.model, COALESCE((SELECT datetime(MIN(s.time_s), 'unixepoch') FROM steps s WHERE s.project = l.project AND s.launch = l.launch), datetime(l.start_s, 'unixepoch')) AS start, datetime(l.end_s, 'unixepoch') AS last_activity, l.retry, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.cache_creation_tokens, l.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(l.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, l.launch FROM launches l WHERE l.provider = 'codex' AND l.project = '${project}' AND l.stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) ORDER BY start, launch
targets.queryText: SELECT 'active' AS status, a.issue, a.model, a.start_time AS start, a.live_time AS last_activity, NULL AS retry, a.input_tokens, a.output_tokens, a.cache_creation_tokens, a.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(a.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, a.launch FROM active_launches a WHERE a.provider = 'codex' AND a.project = '${project}' AND a.stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) AND a.launch NOT IN (SELECT launch FROM launches WHERE provider = 'codex' AND launch IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'done' AS status, l.issue, l.model, COALESCE((SELECT datetime(MIN(s.time_s), 'unixepoch') FROM steps s WHERE s.project = l.project AND s.launch = l.launch), datetime(l.start_s, 'unixepoch')) AS start, datetime(l.end_s, 'unixepoch') AS last_activity, l.retry, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.cache_creation_tokens, l.cache_read_tokens, ROUND(l.weighted) AS weighted_tokens_estimate, l.launch FROM launches l WHERE l.provider = 'codex' AND l.project = '${project}' AND l.stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) ORDER BY start, launch

panels.title: Usage limit in percent (entered by hand)
panels.description: The values entered by hand with run_record.py limit, for the chosen stage.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time, point, percent, plan, entered_by_hand FROM limits WHERE project = '${project}' AND stage = CAST('${stage}' AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time_s, line

panels.title: Loads
panels.description: The time of the last load of monitor.sqlite and of the last failed load.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (SELECT time FROM loads ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_load, (SELECT time FROM loads WHERE status = 'failed' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_failed_load, (SELECT message FROM loads WHERE status = 'failed' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_failed_message
